title: LIN-4254 piece 2: common.js slices onto loadWorld (lin-2370, lin-4242, dashboard-routes badge test via extracted fixture)
description:
## Landed

Implemented as approved in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2325](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2325>) (squash-merged as `3f4d4131`). Deviations: `lin-4242` loads `common.js`, not `question-cards.js`, so the CustomEvent comment sits at the world's load site; `dashboard-routes` was 274 tests at base (273 after the move), not the 257 below; review F1 added `tests/fixtures/proxy-prompt-box.js` so lin-2370, lin-3136 and lin-4296 share one real-renderer cut. The scope, tests and acceptance below are kept as the record. Full history: task snapshots and the comment trail.

---

**Piece 2 of LIN-4254: the** `common.js` **slices.** Lands after Piece 1.

## Slice of the approved plan

`common.js` throws at load without `__HARNESS_MODELS__` (see the `client-world.js` header).

* `tests/unit/lin-2370-browser-copy-prompt-provider-identity.test.js`: move onto `loadWorld`.
* `tests/unit/lin-4242-waiting-live.test.js`: move onto `loadWorld`. It loads `question-cards.js`. **Keep** `CustomEvent` **absent** (`question-cards.js:236` returns without it, which is the only reason this suite avoids the bubbling-`dispatchEvent` stop). Say so in a present-tense comment in the file.
* **The** `dashboard-routes` **client test**, in two commits:
  1. **Pure extraction.** Move the route fixture out of `tests/unit/dashboard-routes.test.js` into one no-`test()` shared module (for example `tests/fixtures/dashboard-router.js`; the builder chooses the name). It covers `makeStores` (`:55`, which brings `withFreshDigests`), `findRouteLayer`/`getHandler` (`:110/:127`), `makeReqRes` (`:132`), `makeRouter` (`:148`, which brings the `withDefaults`-wrapped `createDashboardRoutes` at `:32` and the three `InMemory*` stores) and `decisionItem` (`:325`). Move only multi-use helpers, and say which in the PR. **Review note B:** `decisionItem` reads the module constant `NOW_ISO`, which has 128 uses. Export it from the module and import it back, or pass it in; either way it is computed once at load. After the move, drop the unused `vm` and top-level `readFileSync` imports (the `:4464` use imports its own). `dashboard-routes` imports the module back and never imports `client-world.js`. Witness: identical sorted test names and pass count (257).
  2. **The move.** The test at `:6858` ("the badge paints the page's own workspace number when a second workspace holds a ruling", in `describe('LIN-4103 beat 3 — …')` at `:6836`) goes to a **new** client suite. No unit suite covers `updateRulingsBadge` today. The new suite imports the fixture module, `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })` and `world.run(slice)`. The real route's JSON feeds the real sliced function. **Review note C:**
     * Badge markup comes from `renderRulingsBadge` (`lib/components/navbar.js:325`, not exported). Either render it via `renderNavBar(...)` with `featureFlags.runControls === true` (`:176`), or export it, which is a small production change. Say which in the PR.
     * `common.js:3152`'s selector `[data-rulings-badge][data-url-key="…"]` must now match. That dead path coming alive is intended.
     * Use one fresh `loadWorld` per `paint(urlKey)`, and supply the JSON with `globals: { fetch }`.
     * Keep the describe title, or record the full path in the name map (old file → new file).
     * Remove `dashboard-routes` from the census list.

## Testing (beyond the common strategy)

* Mutation: make the client read `count` instead of `workspaceCount`, and the test goes red.
* Mutation: rename `workspaceCount` in the route, and the test goes red. **Review note D:** this also turns the server-side test at `:6850` red. That is expected; say so in the PR.

## Acceptance

* Three census entries gone, or listed with a true stop.
* The fixture is extracted, not copied.
* `dashboard-routes` names and count are unchanged, apart from the one moved test, which is recorded in the name map.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4254 (Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake). This piece's starting point is the parent's approved **Implementation Plan** in LIN-4254's description, plus the builder notes in its approving Plan Review Verdict (comment `c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7`). Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4254.

**Rules for every piece (from the plan):** "Moved" means the suite runs on `loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` over `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) and its private `vm.createContext` sandbox is deleted. Do not wrap the old sandbox around the fake. Slices and scripts that query the DOM at load use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(source)`, as `observation-ruling-delivery` and LIN-4284 do. Router markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists, not from hand-written HTML. Do not widen the fake. A file that hits an API the fake does not model (a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method such as `click()`) stays on `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` with a `// stop:` comment naming the API and `file:line`. A `querySelector: () => null` stub that becomes a real tree can bring dead paths to life. A test that goes red there is a finding: classify it as a real client bug, a vacuous pass or a fake gap, and list it in the PR. Never loosen the test. Test names are kept. Do not split a file to keep a count, and do not copy a fixture.

**Testing strategy (every move PR):** an assertion map; before/after sorted test names, diffed against base; one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red; and green runs of `fake-dom-census.test.js`, `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` and the full unit suite. The census count only falls. Every remaining entry's reason is true at merge.

**Grounding commits:** plan and approving review at `b581ac92` (Surveys at `b581ac926`); LIN-4292 landed as `b389f9b0`. Re-check `git log b581ac92..origin/main -- tests/unit public` before starting.

**Session fit:** fits one session
**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4254's approving plan-review (comment c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7, rev 2)

comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2325 (branch feat/lin-4308-common-slices-loadworld, head 2fa84134, rebased on main 1d10f9b3)

**CI:** all green, including `CI success`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan.

**What landed (4 commits):**
1. Route fixture extracted to `tests/fixtures/dashboard-router.js` (no test()). Pure move; `dashboard-routes` names identical.
2. Rulings-badge test moved from `dashboard-routes` to new `tests/unit/rulings-badge-client.test.js` on `loadWorld`, using the real navbar badge markup (`renderNavBar`, runControls). No production change. Name map is in the PR.
3. `lin-4242-waiting-live` onto `loadWorld` (real common.js; CustomEvent stays absent, asserted).
4. `lin-2370-browser-copy-prompt-provider-identity` onto `loadWorld` (both client halves).

**Census:** HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES 18 → 15; the three moved files left it.

**Evidence:** full unit suite 23,837/23,837 and hermetic PASS on the rebased tree. Every load-bearing assertion has a red mutation recorded in the PR body.

**Notes:** `dashboard-routes` has 273 tests, not the 257 in the ticket (274 at base). `lin-4242` does not load `question-cards.js` at HEAD, so the CustomEvent comment sits at the world's load site instead.

## Review — LIN-4308 PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2325, reviewed at head `2fa84134` (base `origin/main` `1d10f9b3`). CI: green on head `2fa84134`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success`. ### What I checked myself - **Changed suites at head:** `rulings-badge-client`, `lin-4242`, `lin-2370`, `dashboard-routes`, `fake-dom-census` and `claude-md-line-budget` all pass, 353/353. - **Sorted test names, base vs head (my own run):** - `dashboard-routes` loses exactly one test, "the badge paints the page's own workspace number when a second workspace holds a ruling" (274 → 273). - The new `rulings-badge-client.test.js` holds that test under the same describe title, which matches the name map. - `lin-4242` and `lin-2370` names are identical to base. - **Fixture:** `tests/fixtures/dashboard-router.js` has no `test()`/`describe()`. - It was moved, not copied: the helpers are deleted from `dashboard-routes`. - `NOW_ISO` is computed once and imported back. - `dashboard-routes` no longer imports `vm` or `readFileSync` and never imports `client-world.js`. - **Census:** the three entries were removed (18 → 15) and nothing was added. - **Regression check:** I ran `git log` on every touched file. LIN-4103's server-side `workspaceCount` tests are still in `dashboard-routes` and still go red under the rename mutation (below). Nothing reverted is re-applied. - **Mutations I ran (each reverted; tree clean afterwards):** - M1: `common.js:3149` client reads `body.count`. Badge test red (0/1). - M2: `common.js:3150` selector `data-url-key` → `data-url-kee`. Badge test red. Under the old stub (which ignored the selector) this mutation would have passed, so the dead path is now live, as intended. - M3: route emits `wsCount` instead of `workspaceCount` (`routes/dashboard-rulings.js:120`). Badge test red, and `dashboard-routes` 2 red (271/273), as the PR says for review note D. - M4: `proxy.js:147` drops the clause. lin-2370 2 red. - M5: `common.js:2251` drops the clause. lin-2370 2 red. - M6: `proxy.js` falls back to `'Linear'`. lin-2370 1 red. - M7: `CustomEvent` added to the lin-4242 world. 3 red, so the absence is pinned. - `clickOn` awaits the handler (`client-world.js:35-39`), so the lin-2370 "omits the clause" test is not vacuous on an empty output. Its positive regex also guards it. ### Finding (inside scope, for close-out to fix) **F1: lin-2370's Proxy-page markup is hand-written, but a real renderer exists.** - **Where:** `tests/unit/lin-2370-browser-copy-prompt-provider-identity.test.js`, `runCopyButton`, which sets `body.innerHTML = '

## Close-out — LIN-4308

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2325, squash-merged as `3f4d4131`, pinned with `--match-head-commit bbd847f4`. The change is test-only (`git diff --name-only 1d10f9b3 3f4d4131` lists nothing outside `tests/`), so nothing deploys and there are no post-deploy steps.

**Review verdict:** Approve, conditional on discharging F1. The ledger had one inside item and no outside items.

**Change I made after approval (answers review F1):**
- `bbd847f4` — lin-2370's `runCopyButton` no longer hand-writes the Proxy page's markup. It now uses `PROXY_PROMPT_BOX`, cut from `renderProxyPage('acme', { urlKey: 'acme' })`.
- The cut moved into one shared module, `tests/fixtures/proxy-prompt-box.js`, as review asked ("do not add a third copy"). `lin-3136-settings-take-predicate` and `lin-4296-scope-pick` had identical private copies; they now import it. Their test names are unchanged.
- I rewrapped one doc comment in lin-2370 that the change made stale. That is not an assertion change.

**Ledger:**
- **F1 (inside), settled:**
  - lin-2370 is 11/11 on the renderer cut. The three suites together are 25/25.
  - Distinguishing check: `grep -c 'id="proxy-generate-btn"'` on the test file returns 0, and its markup comes from `renderProxyPage`.
  - M4 (`proxy.js:147` drops the clause) goes red, 2 failing. M5 (`common.js:2251` drops the clause) goes red, 2 failing. M6 (`proxy.js` falls back to `'Linear'`) goes red, 1 failing. Each mutation was reverted and the baseline is 11/11 again.
- **Outside items:** none, so no follow-ups were filed and no related-ticket search was needed.
- **Named monitor or rollback:** none required. The change is test-only.

**Final CI state:** CI exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). On exact head `bbd847f4`: `CI success`, Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4 and Secret scan all passed. I also ran `npm run test:unit` locally: 23,837/23,837, the same count as before the fix. `fake-dom-census` and `claude-md-line-budget` were green (51/51 across both files). The census stays at 15, down from 18.

**Ticket housekeeping:** the pre-prune description was snapshotted and confirmed (snapshot `ad47ba4d`). It contains no embedded plan, research or design sections, only scope, tests and acceptance, so I kept all of it and prepended a short "Landed" stub. The `Plan-review due` line and the session-fit line are untouched. The ticket's "257" test count is still stale; the authoritative figure is 274 at base and 273 after the move.

**Unblocks:** LIN-4309 (piece 3), which this ticket blocks. The parent LIN-4254 stays open for pieces 3–6.
